title: A coherent rank gauge still misses the actual two-full fresh-D endpoint
body:
The actual 632-role two-full source admits an additive coherent rank gauge that satisfies paid closed walks, all unchanged free warp relations, scalar compatibility and same-realization inverses, yet misses the fresh-D endpoint. Taking `λ9=t` and all other rank scalars equal to one scales the main X diagonal but not Y. The retained border then has upper-right term `−t(t−1)/ε` for arbitrary central `Q`.

This identifies the additional necessary main boundary relation `λ9=λ1λ8` (with `λ0=1`). Both source orientations retain every main/helper endpoint: each has 370 scaled and 38 unscaled productive helpers. The formal paired calibration uses distinct 408-role helper banks. This is a focused obstruction outcome of the fresh-D construction claim, not a new supplier or a claim that coherent implementations are impossible.

The written proof handles all inputs and arbitrary Q. Exact stdlib checks authenticate the original word, audit every frame/warp/owned-center boundary, independently propagate all 632 coordinate functionals (2,528 rows across two orientations and two gauges), and verify the arbitrary-Q Laurent identity. The paired numerical replay is explicitly a formal Q=1 specialization, not a physical Gaussian simulation.

Validation at `e028f99c630f6fa2da94787e4f3ec3db9dd0fb3d`: registered Python 3.12.2 normal and optimized checks pass; committed-byte/source-history and official 12-file export checks pass. Actual read-only Git-free replay with PATH unavailable passes unchanged. Corrupted source, changed receipt, removed symbolic pole, reused helper bank and integer-to-float receipt mutants all reject.

The family is an algebraic countermodel on exact coefficient space; no finite-grid recursive implementation or complete realization invoice is supplied. Fixed t≠1 produces a pole as ε→0, while t−1 depending on ε may control it and requires a separate cost analysis. Selected frontier and κ are unchanged.

Credit: Cao Yifan's retained round-three source; Yiyang's PR4966 inverse and two-full wrapper work; Cinna Davis's PR4983 additive-potential/cycle audit. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
